entries.toelichting: Aramaic gentilic exiles-people (Ezra 4:9 Persian-Mesopotamian-accusers).
Surrounding-siege-wall around city (2Kgs 25:1; Jer 52:4; Eze 4:2; 17:17; 21:27; 26:8). Hyphenated to distinguish siege-rampart-aspect from H4692 matsor 'siege' and H5550 solelah 'earth-mound'.
Period of grain-threshing; blessing-promise; Lev 26:5.
Horite tribe-head among Seir's sons (Gen 36:21,25,26,30; 1Chr 1:38,41). English convention: Dishon; distinguished from H1789 Dishan.
Clean food-species wild-buck; Deut 14:5.
Horite tribe-head among Seir's sons (Gen 36:21,28,30; 1Chr 1:38,42). English convention: Dishan; distinguished from H1787 Dishon.
Oppressed as YHWH-care-target (Ps 9:10; 10:18; 74:21; Prov 26:28). Hyphenated to distinguish oppressed-crushed-aspect from H6041 ani 'poor-afflicted' (already assigned) and H6035 anaw 'meek'.
Aramaic demonstrative pronoun (masculine singular) (Ezra 4:13,16,19,21; 5:17; 6:7,8; Dan 2:31; 4:15,27; 7:8,20,21). Linked via '-aramaic' to Hebrew demonstrative-family.
Piel: smash to dust, break in pieces; concordantly 'crush'.

The contrite spirit which God does not despise - Psalm 34:19 (the LORD is near to the broken-hearted and saves the contrite of spirit) and Isaiah 57:15 (I dwell with the contrite and the lowly of spirit).
Second-sense dakka; God turns-man-back-to-dust; Ps 90:3.
Crushed-broken become of heart or bone (Ps 10:10; 44:20; 51:10; 51:19; Isa 19:10; 57:15). Hyphenated to distinguish inwardly-broken-aspect from H5310a natats-II 'shatter' and H4272 machats.
Mutilated-testicles assembly-exclusion; Deut 23:1.
Streams-lift-up-their-roaring; Ps 93:3.
Aramaic demonstrative pronoun for 'this/the-same' - in Daniel 2:18 (concerning this God of heaven) and Daniel 7:20 (and the horn that came up); demonstrative in Daniel's vision-context.
Ezra-sacrifice-temple-dedication-rams-with-lambs and rams-for-trespass-offering (Ezra 6:9,17; 7:17). Hyphenated to distinguish ram-male-sheep-offering-aramaic-aspect from Hebrew H2145 zakar 'male'.
Aramaic memorial-document; Ezra 6:2.
Aramaic memorial-record-royal (Ezra 4:15, 6:2); from root dkr remember.
Socio-economically poor; distinguished from ani (oppressed) and evyon (needy-longing); concordantly 'needy'.
Height or wall leap-up like gazelle (2Sam 22:30; Isa 35:6; Zeph 1:9; Ps 18:30; Song 2:8). Hyphenated to distinguish leaping-stride-aspect from H5425 nathar 'leap-up'.
Water from well-up-pull or person-rescue (Ex 2:16,19; Ps 30:2; Prov 20:5; Isa 38:12). Hyphenated to distinguish well-up-pull-aspect from H5375 nasa 'lift' and H4899 mashach 'draw'.
The poor and lowly as remnant of the people - in 2Kings 24:14 (none remained but the poorest sort of the people of the land) and Jeremiah 40:7 (that he had committed unto him men, women, children).

Poor land-people who remained at exile (2Kgs 24:14; 25:12; Jer 40:7; 52:15,16). Hyphenated to distinguish socially-poor-people from homonym H1803a dallah-I 'thread-hair' (weave); family with H1800 dal.
Eze-with-feet-trouble-waters and Eze-troubled-streams and Eze-troubled-cattle-water (Eze 32:2,13; 34:18). Hyphenated to distinguish trouble-stir-up-muddy-aspect from H7515 rafas 'trample-water'.
Num-water-shall-flow-out-of-his-buckets and Isa-nations-as-drop-in-bucket (Num 24:7; Isa 40:15). Hyphenated to distinguish bucket-water-pail-aspect from H1809 dalal 'diminish'.
Various post-exilic persons (1Chr 3:24; 24:18; Ezra 2:60; Neh 6:10; 7:62; Jer 36:12,25). 'YHWH-has-drawn-up'. English convention: Delaiah.
Philistine woman who extracted Samson's secret (Judg 16:4,6,10,12,13,18). English convention: Delilah.
Hanging vine-branch or tree-branch (Jer 11:16; Eze 17:6,7,23; 19:11; 31:7,9,12). Hyphenated to preserve hanging-shoot-semantics (no H2156 zemorah 'pruning-branch').

Qal/Niphal: gradually-decline-to-powerlessness distinguished from rafah (slacken, H7503) and nafal (fall, H5307) by waste-from-high-to-low-aspect (Judg 6:6, Job 28:4, Ps 79:8, 116:6, 142:7, Isa 17:4, 19:6, 38:14).
Proper noun, Judah-city lowland; Josh 15:38; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Dilan.
The dripping of tears or of a leaking roof - Job 16:20 (to God my eye drips) and Proverbs 19:13 (the contentions of a wife are a continual dropping).

The continual dripping of a leaking roof as image of the contentious wife - Proverbs 19:13 (the contentions of a wife are a continual dropping) and Proverbs 27:15 (a continual dropping in a very rainy day).
Proper noun, second son of Haman; Esth 9:7; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Dalphon.
Qal/Hiphil: kindling-pursue distinguished from baar (burn, H1197a) and radaph (chase) by burning-pursuit-parallelism (Gen 31:36, Ps 7:14, 10:2, Prov 26:23, Obad 18).
Aramaic Peal-participle; throne-flames-burn; Dan 7:9.
Fiery-burning disease-plague; Deut 28:22.
Hapax-form; guard-door-of-my-lips; Ps 141:3.
Jer 36:23 scroll-pages-like-doors; sub-sense pair with H1817a door.
Unique lexeme. 'Door' standard.
Unique lexeme. 'Blood' standard.
Qal: be like, resemble; Piel: imagine as; concordantly 'liken'.
Niphal/Qal: brought to silence, be destroyed; the hyphenated English distinguishes from damah I 'liken'.
Aramaic verb for being-like - in Daniel 3:25 (and the fourth is like the Son of God) and Daniel 7:5 (and it was like a bear); parallel of Hebrew damah.
Hapax-form; Tyre-to-silence-perish-in-sea; Eze 27:32.
From √damah (liken); abstract resemblance, image; concordantly 'likeness' (distinguished from tselem).
Ps-give-no-silence-to-yourself and Isa-silence-before-God-till-he-saves and Isa-watchmen-no-silence-cry (Ps 83:2; Isa 38:10; 62:6,7). Hyphenated.
Enemy-as-lion-eager-to-tear; Ps 17:12.
Qal: become silent, come to silence (people, nature); concordantly 'be-still'.
Second-sense damam; inhabitants-Tyre-island-stand-still; Isa 23:2.

Elijah-soft-still-voice and Job's-soft-floating-stillness and psalm-storm-stillness (1Kgs 19:12; Job 4:16; Ps 107:29). Hyphenated to distinguish silence-soft-whisper-aspect from H8367 sheqet 'quietness'.
Animal-or-corpse-dung as pollution or fertiliser (2Kgs 9:37; Ps 83:11; Jer 8:2; 9:22; 16:4; 25:33). Hyphenated to preserve dung-manure-aspect.
Proper noun, Levi-city of Zebulon; Josh 21:35; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Dimnah.
Shed tears or weep - in Jeremiah 13:17 (my soul shall weep in secret places, and my eye shall weep sore) and Micah 2:6 (prophesy not, said the prophets to them).
Firstling-must-drippings offering; Ex 22:29.
From √dama (drip); fluid of weeping; concordantly 'tear'.
Hapax-form; rest-couch on which Damascus-Israel sat; Amos 3:12.
Proper noun; capital of Aram/Syria; concordantly transliterated.
Proper noun (son/tribe of Israel); concordantly transliterated.
Aramaic demonstrative pronoun: this; the hyphenated English marks language.
Proper noun, Judah-hill-country-city; Josh 15:49; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Dannah.
Gen-Bela-king-Edom-name-of-his-city-Dinhabah and 1Chr-Bela-son-of-Beor-name-of-city-Dinhabah (Gen 36:32; 1Chr 1:43). Hyphenated.
Designation of tribe-Dan (Judg 13:2; 18:1,11,30). Gentilic; family with H1835 Dan.
Variant attestation/spelling alongside H1841; concordantly transliterated.
Proper noun ('God-is-my-judge'); prophet; concordantly transliterated.
Proper noun, place David's-census-route; 2Sam 24:6; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Dan-jaan.
Religious-knowing or insight-knowledge (Job 32:6,10,17; 36:3; 37:16; Dan 12:4). Hyphenated to distinguish know-insight-aspect from H1847 da'ath 'knowledge' and H998 binah 'understanding'.
Mature-discernment of God or human (1Sam 2:3; Job 36:4; 37:16; Ps 73:11; Prov 24:14; Isa 11:9; 28:9; Jer 3:15). Hyphenated to distinguish ripened-insight-awareness from H1847 da'at.
Gadite tribe-prince and father of Eliasaph (Num 1:14; 7:42,47; 10:20). English convention: Deuel. 'God-knows'.
Extinguishing-going-out, often of lamp, fire or hope (Job 6:17; 17:1; 18:5,6; 21:17; Ps 118:12; Prov 13:9; 20:20; 24:20; Isa 43:17). Hyphenated; distinguishes passive-extinguished from H3518 kavah.
Root yd' (H3045). 'Knowledge' preserves the experiential knowing-kernel.
Attack-with-slander against-brother; Ps 50:20.
Gen-Jacob-to-Esau-if-they-overdrive-them-one-day-all-the-flock-will-die and Song-the-voice-of-my-beloved-knocks-open-to-me (Gen 33:13; Song 5:2). Hyphenated.
Num-they-departed-from-wilderness-of-Sin-and-encamped-in-Dophkah and Num-they-departed-from-Dophkah-and-encamped-in-Alush (Num 33:12,13). Hyphenated.
From √daqaq (pulverise); thin, fine-grained (manna 'fine as hoar-frost', lean cows); concordantly 'fine'.
YHWH-spreads-heaven as veils; Isa 40:22.
Gen-Joktan-begat-Jerah-Hadoram-Uzal-Diklah and 1Chr-Diklah (Gen 10:27; 1Chr 1:21). Hyphenated.
Qal/Hiphil: shatter to dust (golden calf, idols), pulverise; the hyphenated English marks intensity.
Aramaic-cognate for breaking to dust (Dan 2:34,35,40,44,45; 7:7,19,23). Hyphenated to mark Aramaic-parallel; family with H1854 daqaq.

Qal/Niphal/Pual: with-pointed-weapon pierce/lance distinguished from naqav (pierce-with-hole, H5344a) (Num 25:8 Phinehas, Judg 9:54 Abimelech's-armour-bearer, 1Sam 31:4, 1Chr 10:4, Isa 13:15, Jer 37:10, 51:4, Lam 4:9, Zech 12:10, 13:3).
Gemstone-marble-species palace-floor; Esth 1:6.
Aramaic-age of kingdom-without-end (Dan 3:33; 4:31,34; Ps 84:11). Hyphenated to distinguish generation-age-aramaic-aspect from H1755 dor 'generation' (already assigned); Aramaic cognate.
Abhorrence or eternal contempt - in Daniel 12:2 (to everlasting abhorrence) and Isaiah 66:24 (they shall be an abhorring unto all flesh); eschatological term for judicial condemnation of the wicked.
Pointed-stick to drive oxen; 1Sam 13:21.
Hapax Eccl 12:11 wise-words-as-ox-goads; sub-sense pair with H1861a goad.
Wise-man of Solomon-time 1Kgs 4:31 (compared with Solomon); son of Mahol-cluster.
Gen-thorns-and-thistles-shall-the-ground-bring-forth and Hos-thorn-and-thistle-on-their-altars (Gen 3:18; Hos 10:8). Hyphenated.
South-direction of temple or land (Deut 33:23; Eze 40:24; 42:13; Eccl 1:6; 11:3). Hyphenated to distinguish south-noon-aspect from H5045 negev 'south-dry' and H3225 yamin 'right-hand-south'.
Great emancipation in jubilee-year, also 'swallow' as noun II; concordantly 'liberty'.
The free-flying bird (swallow-swift) as image of freedom - in Psalm 84:4 (the swallow has a nest where she lays her young) and Proverbs 26:2 (as the bird by wandering, as the swallow by flying).
Aramaic orthographic variant of Darius in Daniel-portions (Dan 6:1,2,7,10,13,26,29; 9:1; 11:1; Ezra 4:5; 5:5,6,7; 6:1,12,13,14,15; Hag 1:1,15; 2:10; Zech 1:1,7; 7:1). Concordantly via '-aramaic'.
Proper noun; Persian kings Darius the Mede and Darius I Hystaspes (Ezra, Dan); concordantly transliterated.
Qal: tread with foot (way, bend bow, tread wine); root of derech; concordantly 'tread'.
Root drk (tread, H1869). Beaten way, also metaphorically 'walk-of-life'. 'Way' covers both.
Darda-Mahol-son-wise-man-of-Solomon's-time and Darda-comparison-figure-wisdom-Solomon (1Kgs 5:11; 1Chr 2:6). English convention: Darda. 'Pearl-of-wisdom' or 'fore-knowledge' (dar-pearl).
Aramaic arm of image-silver (Dan 2:32); cognate Hebrew H2220 zeroa.
Proper noun, wise-man at Solomon-time; 1Chr 2:6; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Dara.
Head of a family of Solomon-servants in the return-list - Ezra 2:56, Nehemiah 7:58.
Root drsh. Investigate, seek answer. 'Inquire' preserves the seek-for-information dimension; 'seek' clashes with baqash (H1245).
Gen-earth-shall-fresh-green-bring-forth and Joel-pastures-wilderness-sprout and Isa-pastures-bring-forth-grassland (Gen 1:11; Joel 2:22; Isa 42:2). Hyphenated.
Fresh green plant-growth (day 3 of Creation); the hyphenated English marks freshness.
From deshen (fat-ash, H1880); Piel/Pual: with fat-oil-pour-over or satiate (Num 4:13 ash-removal of altar, Deut 31:20 Israel grow-fat, Ps 20:4 offering-favourably-receive, 23:5 head-with-oil-anoint).
Ps-well-fed-land and Isa-well-fed-with-fat-marrow and Deut-fat-and-well-fed-against-YHWH-kicks (Ps 22:30; 92:15; Isa 30:23). Hyphenated.
Fatty offering-ash of burnt-altar, fig. abundance; the hyphenated English marks composition.
Persian loanword; official edict of king, law; concordantly 'decree'.
Aramaic form of dat (decree, H1881); royal-edict/law (Ezra 7:12-14,21,25-26 'law of your Mighty-One and law of the king', Dan 2:9,13,15 decree-of-king, 6:5,8,12,15 'law of Medes and Persians', 7:25).

Aramaic word for grass-field or green pasture - in Daniel 4:15 (let his portion be with the beasts in the grass) and Daniel 4:23 (let his portion be with the beasts of the field); parallel of Hebrew deshe.
Aramaic loanword for law-expert or judge - in Daniel 3:2 (the judges) and Daniel 3:3 (the judges); Persian databara, judicial official in court-delegation.
Reubenite-son of Eliab who rebelled with Abiram and Korah against Moses-and-Aaron's-leadership and was-swallowed-by-the-earth (Num 16:1,12,24-25,27, 26:9, Deut 11:6, Ps 106:17).
Dothan-place-where-Joseph-sold and where-Elisha-Aramean-troops-sees (Gen 37:17 twice; 2Kgs 6:13). English convention: Dothan. 'Two-pits' or 'two-springs'.
Gen-Joseph-to-Egyptians-behold-I-have-bought-you-this-day-and-your-land and Eze-behold-therefore-I-also-will-recompense-your-way-upon-your-head (Gen 47:23; Eze 16:43). Hyphenated.
First-sense Aramaic ha; exclamation 'behold-I-see-four-men'; Dan 3:25.
Aramaic deictic-exclamation behold (Dan 2:43 divided-kingdom); alongside H1888a exclamation-other use.
Onomatopoeia of malicious-joy/triumph-cry (Ps 35:21,25, 40:16, 70:4, Job 39:25 war-horse snorts, Isa 44:16, Eze 25:3, 26:2, 36:2); concordantly 'Aha!' as English mocking-exclamation.
Israel-offers-gifts-flesh-offerings vainly; Hos 8:13.
By empty-vanity be misled (2Kgs 17:15; Jer 2:5; 23:16; Job 27:12; Ps 62:11). Hyphenated to preserve vain-misleading-aspect; family with H1892 hevel 'vapour-vanity'.
Vapour, breath, fleetingness; key-word Ecclesiastes for transience; concordantly 'vapour-fleeting'. NL refined audit-2026-04-26: vapour-fleeting preserves root-metaphor h-b-l (vapour/breath).
Second son of Adam; shepherd-offerer killed by Cain (Gen 4:2,4,8,9,25; Job 16:18-analogue; Mat references via Heb OT-context). Homonym of H1892 hevel 'vanity'; proper-name reserved as Abel.

Chalk or tufa-limestone for wall-finishing - in Isaiah 27:9 (when He shall make all the stones of the altar as chalkstones beaten in pieces) and parallel-text; building-material-metaphor for altar-desecration.
Star-gazer verb for dividing the heaven into astrological sectors - in Isaiah 47:13 (let now the astrologers, the stargazers, the monthly prognosticators stand up).
Persian-eunuch-keeper of women's-court (Esth 2:3,8,15). English convention: Hegai. 'Pondering-meditation'.
Qal: muttering-meditate (law), growl (lion), moan (dove); concordantly 'meditate-mutter'.
Ps-take-away-the-wicked-from-king's-presence and Prov-take-away-grapes-and-gold and Isa-would-remove-the-wicked (Ps 115:6; Prov 25:4,5; Isa 27:8). Hyphenated.
Job-thundering-sound-God and Ps-my-meditation-thought-not-hidden and Lam-murmur-of-sighing (Job 37:2; Ps 90:9; Lam 3:62). Hyphenated.
Heart-meditation of wisdom; Ps 49:3.
David's-murmuring-fire-within-heart; Ps 39:3.
Heart-meditation and harp-murmur as music-direction (Ps 9:17; 19:15; 92:4; Lam 3:62). Hyphenated to distinguish meditation-murmur-aspect from H7879 siach 'meditation' (already assigned).
Hapax Eze 42:12 temple-gates-protection; identity uncertain, possibly screen.
Proper noun; Egyptian slave of Sarai, mother of Ishmael; concordantly transliterated.
Descendants of Hagar, nomadic opponents (1Chr 5:10,19,20; 11:38; 27:31; Ps 83:7). English convention: Hagrite.
No-joyful-rumbling more in mountains; Eze 7:7.
Aramaic-court-dignitary alongside satraps and governors (Dan 3:24,27; 4:33; 6:8). Hyphenated to distinguish counsellor-minister-courtier-aramaic-aspect from H3289 ya'ats 'counsel'.
Edomite king, son of Bedad (Gen 36:35-36, 1Chr 1:46); Hadad king of Edom contemporary of Solomon (1Kgs 11:14-25); concordantly transliterated.
Proper noun ('Hadad-is-help'); king of Zobah against David; concordantly transliterated.
Proper noun, place where great-mourning-was; Zech 12:11; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Hadad-Rimmon.
Qal-participle; weaned-child-stretches-hand toward adders'-den; Isa 11:8.
India, the eastern-most province of Ahasuerus' empire of 127 provinces - Esther 1:1 (from Hoddu to Cush) and 8:9; derived from the Indus-river.
Hadoram-son-of-Joktan and Arabian-tribe-head (Gen 10:27; 1Chr 1:21). English convention: Hadoram. Distinguished from David's-envoy to king Tou H1913b Hadoram-II; 'Hadad-is-exalted'.
Second-sense Hadoram as personal-name tribute-master Rehoboam; 2Chr 10:18; concordantly transliterated.
Proper noun, David's-warrior from Naham-Gaash; 2Sam 23:30; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Hiddai.
Qal-imperative; trample-wicked-under-your-sole; Job 40:12.
Low-platform on which feet rest at throne (1Chr 28:2; Ps 99:5; 110:1; 132:7; Lam 2:1; Isa 66:1). Hyphenated to distinguish foot-platform from H134 eden 'socket-base' (base of pillar).
Aramaic for 'cut-into-pieces' become; Dan 3:29.
Fragrant myrtle for Feast of Tabernacles (Neh 8:15; Isa 41:19; 55:13; Zech 1:8,10,11). Hyphenated to mark myrtle-plant-specific.
Proper noun, Hebrew-name of Esther ('myrtle'); Esth 2:7; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Hadassah.

Qal: physical or figurative push-away/expel (Num 35:20,22 manslaughter by push, Deut 6:19 YHWH-thrusts-enemies-away, 9:4, Josh 23:5, 2Kgs 4:27 Shunammite not away, Job 18:18 'from-light-into-darkness-thrust', Prov 10:3, Jer 46:15, Eze 34:21).

Someone or something in honour/glow clothe or oneself exalt (Ex 23:3; Lev 19:15,32; Prov 25:6; Isa 45:2; 63:1; Lam 5:12). Hyphenated; ceremonial-adornment distinguished from H1926 hadar 'glory' (noun).
Dan-aramaic-glorify-the-Most-High-forever and Dan-aramaic-praise-and-glorify-Him and Dan-aramaic-fame-and-glorification (Dan 4:31,34; 5:23). Hyphenated.

Dan-aramaic-majesty-of-my-kingdom and Dan-aramaic-for-the-glory and Dan-aramaic-splendour-for-glory (Dan 4:27,33; 5:18). Hyphenated to distinguish majesty-splendour-aramaic-aspect from H1926 hadar 'glory'.
Proper noun Edomite king; Gen 36:39; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Hadar.
Tax-collector against-royal-glance sent; Dan 11:20.
From √hadar (adorn); shining glory, ornament; concordantly 'glory'.
Sacred dignity of worship (1Chr 16:29; 2Chr 20:21; Ps 29:2; 96:9; Prov 14:28). Hyphenated to distinguish majesty-splendour-aspect from H1935 hod 'majesty' and H1926 hadar.
Lament-cry for day-of-doom; Eze 30:2.
Cry of mourning; Amos 5:16.
Personal pronoun 3ms. Also used as demonstrative ('that one'). English 'he' covers the pronoun; demonstrative function follows from context-position.
Aramaic pers.pron 3ms; parallel to Hebrew hu; concordantly compound with language-marker.
First-sense hava; snow falls-down on earth; Job 37:6.
Archaic-be-become in blessing-Esau and weariness-life (Gen 27:29; Eccl 2:22; 11:3). Hyphenated to distinguish be-become-exist-aspect from homonym H1933a hawah-I 'fall' and H1961 hayah.
Aramaic; concordantly identical to H1961 hayah Hebrew ('become').
Royal or divine glow, dignity; concordantly 'majesty'.
Proper noun, Asher tribe-head son of Zophah; 1Chr 7:37; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Hod.
Proper noun, Levi-clan returnees; Neh 7:43; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Hodvah.
Half-tribe-Manasseh-family-head and Benjamite and Levite-family-ancestor (1Chr 3:24; 5:24; 9:7; Ezra 2:40). English convention: Hodaviah. 'YHWH-praise'; family with H1935 hod.
Proper noun, son of Elioenai-David-branch; 1Chr 3:24; concordantly transliterated.
Judah-wife of Mered and Levite-expounders and covenant-sealers (1Chr 4:19; Neh 8:7; 9:5; 10:10,13,18). English convention: Hodiah. 'Majesty-is-YHWH'; family with H1935 hod.
A Levite who supported the explanation of the law and signed the covenant under Nehemiah - Nehemiah 8:7, 9:5, 10:10, 10:13, 10:18; name means 'my praise is YHWH'.
Pernicious longing, mischievous-desire (Proverbs, Psalms); the hyphenated English marks malicious craving.
Isa-calamity-upon-calamity-shall-come and Eze-mischief-on-mischief and Isa-doom-unforeseen (Isa 47:11; Eze 7:26). Hyphenated to distinguish calamity-ruin-doom-aspect from H7451 ra 'evil'.
Proper noun, king of Hebron; Josh 10:3; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Hoham.
Exclamation: complaint/warning; concordantly 'woe' (distinguished from oi).
Aramaic-go-move of king or fire (Ezra 5:5; 6:5; 7:13; Dan 3:25; 4:34). Hyphenated to distinguish go-walk-aspect from H236 azal-aramaic 'go-away-aramaic'; Aramaic cognate of H1980 halakh.
Root √hll-II (be-foolish); abstract-plural delusions Ecclesiastes.
Hapax Eccl 10:13 mouth's-end-madness; sub-sense H1947 holeloth folly (masculine).
Tumult-unrest-stir in city or crowd (Ruth 1:19; Deut 7:23; 1Sam 4:5; 1Kgs 1:45; Ps 55:3; Mic 2:12). Hyphenated to distinguish confusion-tumult-aspect from H2000 hamam 'in-confusion-bring'.
Proper noun variant Hemam son of Lotan; 1Chr 1:39; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Homam.
Hiphil; people presumptuous-go-up-mountain; Deut 1:41.
Riches, possessions, sufficient-enough (Prov); concordantly 'wealth'.
Proper noun, son of Jeconiah; 1Chr 3:18; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Hoshama.
Proper noun ('deliverance'); original name of Joshua, and prophet Hosea, and last king of Israel; concordantly transliterated.
Hoshaiah-leader-people's-leader-wall-dedication and Hoshaiah-father-Azariah-Jeremiah-mocker and Hoshaiah-after-temple-procession (Neh 12:32; Jer 42:1; 43:2). English convention: Hoshaiah.
1Chr-and-Hodaviah-the-son-of-Hassenuah and Ezra-the-children-of-Hodaviah-seventy-four (1Chr 9:7; Ezra 2:40 par-spelling-Hodewah). Hyphenated.
Qal-participle; seer-dogs-sleep-and-dream; Isa 56:10.
Scroll-full-of-mourning-and-lamentation; Eze 2:10.
Harvest-shout at winepress or war-cry (Isa 16:9,10; Jer 25:30; 48:33; 51:14; Eze 30:5). Hyphenated to preserve joy-cry-context.
Levitical praise-leadership under Mattaniah; Neh 12:8.
Root hyh/hwh, dynamic: become, happen. Hebrew has no verb for static being (nominal sentence carries that). 'Become' preserves the dynamic character; 'be' loses it.
Job: 'if my grief and my calamity were weighed'; Job 6:2.
Dan-then-the-king-sent-and-Daniel-said-to-him-how-shall-this-servant-of-my-lord-with-this-my-lord-speak and Song-id (Dan 10:17). Hyphenated.
Loanword from Sumerian/Akkadian; both royal palace and YHWH-temple; the hyphenated English preserves both.
Aramaic form of hekhal (H1964); royal palace Nebuchadnezzar (Dan 4:4,29), Belshazzar (Dan 5:5), YHWH-temple (Ezra 4:14, 5:14-15, 6:5, Dan 5:2-3); concordantly 'palace-temple-aramaic'.
Hapax for Babel-king ('shining-son-of-dawn'); Isa 14:12.
Proper noun, son of Lotan; Gen 36:22; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Hemam.

Wise-man named alongside Solomon (1Kgs 4:31); Levitical singer and prophet, son of Joel, grandson of Samuel (1Chr 6:33, 15:17-19, 16:41-42, 25:1-6, 2Chr 5:12, 35:15); poet of Ps 88; concordantly transliterated.
Liquid measure about 3.6 litres, used at offerings; transliteration retained.
Hiphil; Job: how-long-will-you-reproach-me; Job 19:3.
Face-expression of people testifies-against-itself; Isa 3:9.
Niphal-participle; Zion's-people weary-and-scattered; Mic 4:7.
Direction-adverb: further, thither, henceforth; concordantly 'onward'.
Lev-fourth-year-shall-all-fruit-be-holy-festival-joy-LORD and Judg-they-went-out-of-the-vineyards-and-the-grape-treading-festival-joy (Lev 19:24; Judg 9:27). Hyphenated.

Strengthened demonstrative pronoun 'that-yonder-over-there' (Gen 37:19; Judg 6:20; 1Sam 14:1; 17:26; 20:19; 2Kgs 4:25; 23:17; Eze 36:35; Dan 8:16). Hyphenated; deictic-strengthened distinct from H2088 ze.
Gen-who-is-that-man-coming-in-the-field-towards-us and Gen-this-dreamer-comes (Gen 24:65; 37:19). Hyphenated.
Land-this-desolate-shall-become-as-Eden; Eze 36:35.
Job's-footstep with-cream-bathed in former-days; Job 29:6.
Walking-passages or caravan-journey (Job 6:19; Nah 2:6; Hab 3:6; Ps 68:25; Prov 31:27). Hyphenated to distinguish journey-walk-aspect from H4109 mahalakh; family with H1980 halakh.
Root hlk. Iterative/habitual motion (vs. yalak, purely directional). 'Walk' covers both physical and figurative 'walk-with'.
Dan-aramaic-walking-in-midst-fire and Dan-aramaic-Nebuchadnezzar-walked-palace-Babel and Ezra-aramaic-keeping (Dan 3:25; 4:26,34; Ezra 6:5). Hyphenated.
Honey that in forest of itself flowed; 1Sam 14:26.
Aramaic-Persian loanword for travel-tax; Ezra 7:24.
Job-God-moon-not-shines and Job-stars-not-pure-shine and Isa-no-more-shines-sun-on-you (Job 25:5; 29:3; 31:26; Isa 13:10). Hyphenated.
Root hll. Piel-shine, boast, praise. 'Praise' preserves the praise-utterance.

Third homonym distinguished from halal-I (shine, H1984a) and halal-II (praise, H1984b); Poel/Poal/Hithpoel: act-foolish/madly (Job 12:17 'he-makes counsellors-fools', 1Sam 21:14, Eccl 1:17, 2:2,12, 7:7, Ps 5:6, 73:3, 75:5).
Judg-after-him-judged-Israel-Abdon-the-son-of-Hillel and Judg-Abdon-son-of-Hillel-the-Pirathonite-died (Judg 12:13,15). Hyphenated.
With heavy blow strike; sometimes of tent-peg-driving (Judg 5:22,26; 1Sam 14:16; Ps 74:6; 141:5; Prov 23:35; Isa 16:8; 28:1; 41:7). Hyphenated; distinguishes heavy-blow-action from H5221 nakah.
Proper noun, Asher tribe-head brother of Shomer; 1Chr 7:35; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Helem.

Demonstrative-place-adverb 'unto-here/hitherward' distinguished from henna (hither, H2008) by direction-to-this-point-aspect (Ex 3:5 YHWH-to-Moses at-burning-bush, Judg 18:3, Ruth 2:14, 1Sam 14:38, 2Sam 7:18, 20:16).
Workmen-hammer; Jael's-tool; Judg 5:26.
Proper noun, place where Zuzim were defeated; Gen 14:5; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Ham.
Hapax-form; nothing-of-people-nothing-remains; Eze 7:11.
Personal pronoun 3mp. Counterpart of hu (H1931, 3ms). 'They' is standard plural.
Qal: roar (sea), tumult (multitude), moan (heart); concordantly 'roar'.
Aramaic personal pronoun third person plural (Ezra 4:10,23; 5:11,12,15; 6:5; 7:17; Dan 2:34,35,44; 3:22,27). Concordantly via '-aramaic'.
Root hmh (roar). Tumultuous multitude. Semantically parallel to rov (H7230). Concordantly 'multitude' for both; Strong-distinction preserved.
Hapax-form; you-all wilder-than-heathen; Eze 5:7.
Proper noun Hamon-Gog ('multitude of Gog') - compound place-name for valley where Gog is buried - in Ezekiel 39:11 (it shall be called the valley of the multitude of Gog) and Ezekiel 39:15.
Proper noun ('multitude-city') Gog-grave; Eze 39:16; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Hamonah.
Babel's-harp-murmur-stopped in dead-realm; Isa 14:11.
Rumbling or tumult - in Ezekiel 1:24 (as the noise of a great army) and Jeremiah 11:16 (with the noise of a great tumult He has kindled fire on it); from H1993 hamah (roar, woel).
Qal: shatter-shock, bring into panic (God against enemies); the hyphenated English marks effect.
Proper noun; opponent in Esther; concordantly transliterated.
Aramaic-golden necklace as honour-distinction (Dan 5:7,16,29). Hyphenated to preserve Aramaic-neck-jewel-aspect; loanword from Persian.
Fire-as-dry-wood-causes-flame; Isa 64:2.
Pers.pron. 3 pers. pl. feminine: they (Leah's children 'they came'); the hyphenated English marks gender.
Presentative particle, secondary form of hinneh (H2009). Concordantly parallel 'behold!'.

Aramaic-cognate of-Hebrew-H518a im (if) distinguished by Aramaic-language-form in-Daniel (Dan 2:5-6 Nebuchadnezzar's-threat 'if-aramaic you-do-not-make-known-to-me the-dream and-its-interpretation, you-shall-be-cut-in-pieces').
Second-sense Aramaic hen; perhaps-there-prolonging-might-be; Dan 4:27.
Third person plural feminine personal pronoun; distinguished from hennah I (hither); the hyphenated English marks gender.
Direction-adverb (especially with Kamatz); distinguished from henah II (they-feminine); concordantly 'hither'.
Presentative particle that draws attention. 'Behold!' preserves the deictic function; 'see' loses the attention-call.
Provincial-rest granted at Esther's-coronation; Esth 2:18.
Place-name 'Hinnom' in construct 'valley/son of Hinnom' south of Jerusalem (Josh 15:8, 18:16, 2Kgs 23:10, 2Chr 28:3, 33:6, Jer 7:31-32, 19:2-6, 32:35); concordantly transliterated.
Hena-Assyrian-conquered-city which-Rabshakeh-mentions (2Kgs 18:34; 19:13; Isa 37:13). English convention: Hena. Assyrian-toponym of uncertain-origin-possibly 'Anat'.

Exclamation/gesture for silence-call (Num 13:30; Judg 3:19; Neh 8:11; Amos 6:10; 8:3; Hab 2:20; Zeph 1:7; Zech 2:17). Hyphenated; distinguishes imperative 'shh!'-action from H2814 chashah 'be-silent'.
My-eye-pours-tears without-pause; Lam 3:49.
Root hpk. 'Turn-over' preserves the turn-around-kernel.

Reversal or perversion - in Isaiah 29:16 (you turners of things upside down, shall the potter be esteemed as the clay?) and Ezekiel 16:34 (it is reversed with you, contrary to women); from H2015 hafakh.
People-pervert roles-potter-clay; Isa 29:16.
Destructive-overthrow Sodom-Gomorrah; Gen 19:29.
Guilty-man's-way is perverse-and-strange; Prov 21:8.
Mordecai's-utterance: deliverance from elsewhere; Esth 4:14.
Enemy-equipment of shields and chariots; Eze 23:24.
